The '''Great Zhell''', later known as the city of '''Zhell''', was an ancient settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Notron]], homeworld of the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] and the [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]] species. Built on a high mountain, the city was named after the thirteen nations of [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]], but the technologically primitive species did not realize that the city was built upon a volcano. During the [[Zhell–Taung war|war between the two species]], the city was seized by the Taung forces led by [[Rexutu the Unconquerable]]. However, the Taung forces took heavy losses, and the Zhell decided to siege the city and gathered a massive force at the base of the mountain. As the sun rose, the Zhell prepared to charge, but the volcano erupted and threw the Zhell forces into chaos. The Taungs took advantage of their enemy's confusion and charged, later commemorating the battle in the poem ''[[Dha Werda Verda]]''.<ref name="EGW" /> The Zhell would later recover, and drive the Taung offworld.
